text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer studies training data that contains both inputs and correct answers. From this data, it builds a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess whether an email is spam or not. To check how well the model works, we measure its accuracy, meaning how often its predictions are correct. The more good training data it gets, the better its predictions usually become.
